dark.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace
dark._notes: Exact copy of the :root block in website/css/style.css (read 2026-08-12). Key = CSS custom property minus the leading '--'; value = verbatim CSS value (hex kept case-sensitive as written in the stylesheet). No adjustments.

light.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace

_notes.bg: Inversion of #050607: near-white cool gray; keeps the blue-charcoal hue family of the dark theme.
_notes.bg-soft: Slightly darker than bg (mirrors dark, where bg-soft is lighter than bg).
_notes.panel: Mid-gray surface, darker than card — mirrors dark mode's panel < card luminance relationship.
_notes.card: Pure white raised surface; light-mode equivalent of #171B1F.
_notes.border: Subtle gray-blue border; visible on both white and #EFF1F4 surfaces.
_notes.muted: Darkened from #A6ADB5 to hold WCAG AA (~4.6:1) on white; dark-mode muted only passed on dark bg.
_notes.accent: Brand hue kept (mint green), darkened from #00E5A0 to #00A87A for WCAG AA contrast on white/light surfaces.
_notes.accent2: Companion green darkened from #00B87E to keep the accent->accent2 gradient relationship intact.
_notes.green: Darkened from #2FD6A1 for legibility of status/terminal text on light backgrounds.
_notes.amber: Darkened from #FFB454 (was decorative-only bright) to a readable amber-brown on white.
_notes.red: Darkened from #FF6B6B for error-text contrast on light backgrounds.
